lines.en: label shrine30:
scene mayalantern1
I spot Maya shortly after arriving at the shrine and make my way over to her.
lines.zh: 到神社后不久我就发现了 Maya，于是朝她走了过去。

lines.en: It’s still suspiciously warm around here (For reasons I’ve yet to understand), but it seems that she’s taken up shelter in a booth with her back to a pair of large glowing lanterns.
lines.zh: 这一带还是热得可疑（原因我至今没弄明白），不过她似乎躲进了一间小屋，背对着一对巨大的、发着光的灯笼。

lines.en: I can feel their heat from here, which is great considering her gaze is ice cold.
lines.zh: 我在这儿都能感觉到它们的热度，考虑到她的目光冷得像冰，这倒是件好事。

lines.en: Here’s hoping they thaw her out sometime soon.
lines.zh: 希望它们能早点把她捂化。

lines.en: : Yo.
: What’s up?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: : Are you ignoring me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在无视我吗？

lines.en: : I’m conserving energy.
lines.zh: : 我在保存能量。

lines.en: : Are you about to go into hibernation for the rest of the winter or something?
lines.zh: : 你是打算在冬天剩下的日子里进入冬眠还是怎么的？

lines.en: : I wish.
lines.zh: : 我也希望。

lines.en: : What do you need to conserve energy for?
lines.zh: : 你需要保存能量干什么？

lines.en: : Daily activities. Getting out of bed. Brushing my teeth.
lines.zh: : 日常活动。起床。刷牙。

lines.en: : An overabundance of stress from having to put up with you all the time.
lines.zh: : 还有因为一直得忍着你而产生的过量压力。

lines.en: : The usual.
lines.zh: : 老样子。

lines.en: : Is there an extra spot inside of that booth? There’s this one girl who keeps bossing me around and it’s getting to me as well.
lines.zh: : 那间小屋里还有位置吗？有这么一个女孩一直使唤我，我也有点受够了。

lines.en: scene mayalantern2
: Stop saying that I’m bossing you around. I haven’t asked you to do a single thing today.
lines.zh: : 别再说我使唤你了。我今天一件事都还没让你做。

lines.en: : I mean...I just got here.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我才刚到。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} got the message loud and clear the other night.
lines.zh: : 而且那天晚上{i}我{/i}可是把话听得很清楚了。

lines.en: : You’re not going to ignore Noriko, so I’m just going to have to figure out a new way to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 你不会无视 Noriko，所以我只能另想办法来应对这件事。

lines.en: : If you wind up disappearing, though, don’t say I didn’t warn you.
lines.zh: : 不过如果你最后消失了，别说我没提醒过你。

lines.en: : I mean...you wouldn’t be able to say anything because you disappeared. But you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你消失了也就说不出话了。但你懂我的意思。

lines.en: : It’s not like she has anything interesting to tell you anyway. Your old life was boring and sad.
lines.zh: : 反正她也没什么有意思的事能告诉你。你的前世既无聊又悲惨。

lines.en: : You get really grumpy when you’re stressed, huh?
lines.zh: : 你压力大的时候脾气真的很差，是吧？

lines.en: : I’m hungry, too. But I have to hang out at this stupid shrine and pretend there is a god.
lines.zh: : 我还饿着。可我得待在这座破神社里，假装这世上有个神。

lines.en: : It’s quite taxing.
lines.zh: : 这相当累人。

lines.en: : Just leave if you hate it here that much.
lines.zh: : 既然这么讨厌这儿，走就是了。

lines.en: : Let’s go get lunch or something.
lines.zh: : 我们去吃午饭什么的吧。

lines.en: scene mayalantern3
: Together?
lines.zh: : 一起？

lines.en: : Maya, we’ve eaten together several times.
lines.zh: : Maya，我们一起吃过好几次饭了。

lines.en: : Not {i}lunch{/i}, though.
lines.zh: : 可没吃过「{i}午饭{/i}」。

lines.en: : We’ve always gone out late at night so I wouldn’t feel weird about anyone seeing us together.
lines.zh: : 我们一直都是深夜才出去，这样我就不会因为有别人看见我们在一起而觉得别扭。

lines.en: : And I was only fine with Uta seeing us because, until recently, I didn’t think it was possible for fate to get so out of sorts that she’d wind up several desks away from me.
lines.zh: : 而我之所以能接受被 Uta 看见，是因为直到不久前，我还以为命运再怎么脱轨，也不至于让她坐到离我只有几张课桌远的地方。

lines.en: : And even though all we did was eat, I now have to face her constant accusations about us being boyfriend and shrine maiden.
lines.zh: : 而且明明我们只是吃了顿饭，现在我得面对她没完没了的指控，说什么我们是男朋友和巫女。

lines.en: : Why not just say “boyfriend and girlfriend?”
lines.zh: : 为什么不干脆说「男朋友和女朋友」？

lines.en: : I was about to, but I got nauseous.
lines.zh: : 我本来要说的，但我恶心了。

lines.en: : I figured as much.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry if I were you, though.
lines.zh: : 不过如果我是你，我不会担心。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure that everyone knows we’re not romantically involved by now.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定，到现在大家早就知道我们之间没有恋爱关系了。

lines.en: scene mayalantern4
: Yeah...I don’t really know if that’s exactly true anymore.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我真不确定这话现在还算不算准确。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that my...reaction to Noriko’s appearance in class has caused some people to second guess the nature of our relationship.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我对 Noriko 出现在班上这件事的……反应，让一些人开始重新猜测我们关系的性质。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的假的？

lines.en: : Well, I guess this means we have to start dating.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我看我们得开始交往了。

lines.en: scene mayalantern5
: Please don’t joke about things like that.
lines.zh: : 拜托别拿这种事开玩笑。

lines.en: : Until now, I managed to fly completely under the radar and not get wrapped up in any of your senseless hidden romance drama.
lines.zh: : 直到现在，我都完美地躲在雷达之下，从没被卷进你那些毫无意义的隐秘恋爱闹剧里。

lines.en: : Now, even Ayane is accusing me of having feelings for you. And I hate seeing Ayane act serious. It’s unsettling.
lines.zh: : 现在连 Ayane 都在指控我对你有感情。而我最讨厌看 Ayane 认真的样子。那让人心里发毛。

lines.en: : Yeah...that doesn’t happen often, does it?
lines.zh: : 是啊……那种事不常发生，对吧？

lines.en: : The point is...it’s important, now more than ever, for the two of us to maintain distance.
lines.zh: : 重点是……如今比以往任何时候都更重要的，是我们两个要保持距离。

lines.en: : Ever? In all of the gajillion years we’ve known each other?
lines.zh: : 以往？在我们认识的那几亿亿年里？

lines.en: scene mayalantern6
: First off, that’s not even a real number.
lines.zh: : 首先，那根本不是个真实的数字。

lines.en: : Secondly, don’t get into semantics with me.
lines.zh: : 其次，别跟我抠字眼。

lines.en: : When someone says “now more than ever” it very rarely means “now more than ever.”
lines.zh: : 当有人说「如今比以往任何时候都更」的时候，它极少真的指「如今比以往任何时候都更」。

lines.en: : It just means that it’s extremely important. Which it is.
lines.zh: : 它只是表示这件事极其重要。而它确实极其重要。

lines.en: scene mayalantern7
: The two of us are not to be seen out and about with one another. There is far too much at stake.
lines.zh: : 我们两个不许被人看见一起在外面走动。风险太大了。

lines.en: : This has been a rule for a very long time, Sensei. You should be fully aware of it by now.
lines.zh: : 这条规矩已经存在很久了，Sensei。你到现在应该完全清楚才对。

lines.en: : I never really thought of it as a “rule.” I just figured that’s how you are.
lines.zh: : 我从来没把它当成什么「规矩」。我只是以为你就是那样。

lines.en: : And in thinking that, you are exactly right.
lines.zh: : 你这么想，完全正确。

lines.en: : I’m cold and blunt. A kuudere with slowly dissipating “cool” and “dere” buried somewhere so far underground that you’ll likely never find it.
lines.zh: : 我冷漠又直率。一个高冷正在慢慢消散、而「娇」被埋在地下深得你大概永远也找不到的冰山女。

lines.en: Yeah, I'm pretty sure I found it when she almost [rape]d me the other night.
lines.zh: 是啊，我敢肯定，那天晚上她差点就[rape]了我的时候，我就找到它了。

lines.en: : The “dere” part exists?
lines.zh: : 「娇」那部分是存在的？

lines.en: : That was mostly a joke. You weren’t meant to take it seriously.
lines.zh: : 那基本上是个玩笑。你本来不该当真的。

lines.en: : Too late. I need to go buy a shovel.
lines.zh: : 太晚了。我得去买把铲子。

lines.en: : See you, Maya.
lines.zh: : 回头见，Maya。

lines.en: scene mayalantern8
: You’re disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: : That may very well be true, but I’m not the one under suspicion, now am I?
lines.zh: : 这也许是真的，可现在被怀疑的人不是我，对吧？

lines.en: : What are you talking about? You’re literally always under suspicion.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么？你才是字面意义上永远都在被怀疑的那个。

lines.en: : Any of those poor girls who think you’re not two...three...or ten-timing them are just choosing to be ignorant about it.
lines.zh: : 那些可怜的女孩里，任何一个以为你没在脚踏两条……三条……或者十条船的，都只是选择对此一无所知罢了。

lines.en: : And yet {i}you’re{/i} the one Ayane is apparently questioning.
lines.zh: : 可「{i}你{/i}」才是 Ayane 显然在质问的人。

lines.en: : Oh please. As if she hasn’t questioned you as well.
lines.zh: : 拜托。她难道没质问过你吗。

lines.en: : What did you tell her? That you can’t promise to be with only her but that she’s still extremely important to you or blah blah blah?
lines.zh: : 你跟她说了什么？说你不能承诺只和她一个人在一起，但她对你来说依然极其重要，或者诸如此类的废话？

lines.en: : Wow. You really {i}are{/i} grouchy today.
lines.zh: : 哇。你今天「{i}真的{/i}」很暴躁。

lines.en: : The grouchiest.
lines.zh: : 暴躁至极。

lines.en: : I can’t remember the last time I actually had to think this much. It’s putting me on edge.
lines.zh: : 我都记不清上一次真的需要动这么多脑子是什么时候了。这让我很烦躁。

lines.en: : Well {i}I{/i} personally like this side of you.
lines.zh: : 不过「{i}我{/i}」个人挺喜欢你这一面的。

lines.en: : It feels like we’re getting somewhere.
lines.zh: : 感觉我们终于有进展了。

lines.en: : {i}This{/i} is your idea of getting somewhere? Slightly more facial expressions and openly confronting you about your relationships with my friends?
lines.zh: : 「{i}这{/i}」就是你所谓的进展？多几个面部表情，再公开就你和我朋友们的关系来质问我？

lines.en: : Sure. We’re talking about things I can finally understand.
lines.zh: : 对啊。我们在聊我终于能听懂的东西了。

lines.en: : You understand all of the other stuff we talk about as well. You just choose to act aloof about it because the second a theory starts sitting in your head, it becomes too real and you want to run away.
lines.zh: : 我们聊的其他东西你也听得懂。你只是选择装作漠不关心，因为一旦某个理论开始在你脑子里扎根，它就变得太真实了，而你想逃。

lines.en: : It’s just how your brain is wired.
lines.zh: : 你的脑子就是这么长的。

lines.en: : Mine is the same way, but with less pent up sexual aggression and more quantum theory and food.
lines.zh: : 我的也一样，只不过压抑的性冲动少一点，量子理论和食物多一点。

lines.en: if mayadorm35 == True:
: Trivia time. Which of the two participants in this conversation has mounted the other in an effort to coerce them into sex?
lines.zh: : 问答时间。这场对话的两个参与者里，哪一个曾经骑在另一个身上、试图胁迫对方发生性行为？

lines.en: scene mayalantern2
: Stop bringing that up!
lines.zh: : 别再提那件事了！

lines.en: : I'm just countering your whole thing about not being sexually aggressive when my personal experiences prove otherwise.
lines.zh: : 我只是在反驳你那套「没有性攻击性」的说法，而我的亲身经历证明恰恰相反。

lines.en: : That didn't count! It was an act of desperation, not sexual aggression!
lines.zh: : 那不算！那是绝望之举，不是性攻击性！

lines.en: : I'm done talking about this!
lines.zh: : 我不想再谈这个了！

lines.en: else:
: Is there any sexual aggression in there at all?
lines.zh: : 那里面到底有没有一点性攻击性？

lines.en: : Up until now, I’ve gotten a really intense asexual vibe from you.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止，我从你身上感受到的是一种非常强烈的无性恋氛围。

lines.en: : Good. Please continue to think that. I’m not open to discussing those sorts of things.
lines.zh: : 很好。请继续这么想。我不打算讨论那种事。

lines.en: : You’re such a buzzkill.
lines.zh: : 你真是个扫兴的人。

lines.en: : How? You have half a classroom worth of girls who you’re likely sleeping with already. Talk to one of them about that if you truly need to.
lines.zh: : 怎么扫兴了？你大概已经在和半个教室的女孩上床了。要是你真需要聊这个，去找她们中的一个说啊。

lines.en: : I’ll continue to sit inside this booth and think about clouds.
lines.zh: : 我要继续坐在这间小屋里想云。

lines.en: : Okay, so let’s say that...theoretically, I {i}am{/i} sleeping with some of the girls.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我们假设……理论上，我「{i}确实{/i}」在和其中一些女孩上床。

lines.en: : How would that make you feel?
lines.zh: : 那你会有什么感觉？

lines.en: : What is this?
lines.zh: : 这是什么？

lines.en: : Are you trying to get me to say I’m jealous?
lines.zh: : 你是想让我说我嫉妒吗？

lines.en: : I’m searching for the “dere.”
lines.zh: : 我在找那个「娇」。

lines.en: scene mayalantern9
: Hah...
: I’d feel the same exact way I’ve felt all along.
lines.zh: : 我的感觉会和一直以来完全相同。

lines.en: : You’re a horrible person with a disgusting addiction and an affinity for girls well under the age you should be setting your sights on.
lines.zh: : 你是个可怕的人，有着恶心的癖好，还喜欢那些远低于你该盯着的年龄的女孩。

lines.en: scene mayalantern10
: And even though I think that side of you is despicable and wish it would go away...I don’t hold it against anyone.
lines.zh: : 虽然我觉得你那一面令人作呕、希望它消失……可我不会因此怪罪任何人。

lines.en: : Well, maybe I do hold it against you. But not any of them.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许我确实怪你。但不怪她们中的任何一个。

lines.en: : They’re just normal girls who are blissfully unaware that they’re caught in a loop.
lines.zh: : 她们只是普通的女孩，幸福地不知道自己被困在了一个循环里。

lines.en: : Falling for version after version of the same [high_school] teacher but failing to truly capture him each and every time.
lines.zh: : 一版又一版地爱上同一个[high_school]老师，却每一次都没能真正抓住他。

lines.en: : It’s actually quite sad...watching them bend and break so many times.
lines.zh: : 看着她们一次次弯折、破碎，其实挺可悲的……

lines.en: : Wait, what happened to their memories persisting through resets? What’s all this about bending and breaking?
lines.zh: : 等等，她们的记忆不是会穿过重置保留下来吗？这些弯折和破碎又是什么？

lines.en: scene mayalantern11
: Perhaps you’ll find out in due time?
lines.zh: : 也许你到时候自然会知道？

lines.en: : Unless, of course, you wind up poking your nose deeper into the past and get your slate wiped clean again.
lines.zh: : 当然，除非你非要往过去里深挖，把自己的记录再次抹得一干二净。

lines.en: : Are you saying that once I’m gone, they’ll be gone too?
lines.zh: : 你是说，一旦我消失，她们也会消失？

lines.en: : Is that what you think?
lines.zh: : 你是这么想的吗？

lines.en: : I’ve given up on thinking when it comes to getting all deep and introspective like this.
lines.zh: : 凡是遇上这种深刻又内省的话题，我早就放弃思考了。

lines.en: : Boy, do I wish I could do that.
lines.zh: : 天哪，我真希望我也能那样。

lines.en: : Take a moment and think back to when you first arrived here.
lines.zh: : 花点时间回想一下你刚到这儿的时候。

lines.en: : Everyone already had preconceived notions of the type of person you were, correct?
lines.zh: : 每个人都已经对你是什么样的人抱有先入为主的印象，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah. But wasn’t that just because that’s how the original Sensei was?
lines.zh: : 是啊。可那不就是因为原本的 Sensei 就是那样吗？

lines.en: : Interesting theory.
lines.zh: : 有趣的理论。

lines.en: : I can see why you’d think something like that.
lines.zh: : 我能理解你为什么会那么想。

lines.en: : But you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 可你错了。

lines.en: : What you were witnessing in those moments were their memories being rewritten.
lines.zh: : 你在那些时刻所目睹的，是她们的记忆被重写。

lines.en: : Didn’t you think it was strange how quickly some of them warmed up to you despite undergoing a complete switch in personalities?
lines.zh: : 你难道不觉得奇怪吗——尽管你的性格完全换了一个人，她们中的一些却那么快就和你热络起来？

lines.en: : How everyone just {i}decided{/i} that not actually being taught anymore was a totally normal thing?
lines.zh: : 所有人怎么就那么{i}「理所当然」{/i}地接受了「不再真的上课」这件事？

lines.en: : Are you familiar with computers? I want to make a comparison, but I’m not sure if you’ll understand.
lines.zh: : 你熟悉电脑吗？我想做个类比，但不确定你能不能听懂。

lines.en: : Feel free. I’m already lost, so any comparison at all could possibly help.
lines.zh: : 请说。我已经晕了，所以任何类比都可能有帮助。

lines.en: : Computers don’t have brains like humans do. They have hard drives.
lines.zh: : 电脑没有人类那样的脑子。它们有硬盘。

lines.en: : Over time, those hard drives fill up with information a user collects and saves.
lines.zh: : 随着时间推移，那些硬盘会被用户收集和保存的信息填满。

lines.en: : If a household only has one computer and every resident of the house uses it, that storage space will begin to fill up rather quickly.
lines.zh: : 如果一户人家只有一台电脑，而家里每个人都用它，那块存储空间很快就会开始告急。

lines.en: : So, in order to make space for new information, old information needs to be deleted.
lines.zh: : 所以，为了给新信息腾出空间，旧信息就得被删掉。

lines.en: : Or reformatted entirely in more severe cases.
lines.zh: : 或者在更严重的情况下，被彻底格式化。

lines.en: : What you were experiencing in watching those girls adapt to you was a type of reformatting.
lines.zh: : 你看着那些女孩适应你的过程，所经历的就是一种格式化。

lines.en: : They were freeing up space in their minds to make room for the “new” you.
lines.zh: : 她们在清空自己脑中的空间，好为「新」的你腾出位置。

lines.en: : And unless you do something to ruin them, which you likely will since you are horrible, that will be how they remain until a new user comes along.
lines.zh: : 而除非你做出什么把她们毁掉的事——你很可能会，因为你很烂——否则她们就会一直保持那样，直到下一个用户出现。

lines.en: : Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 你明白了吗？

lines.en: : I think so...but...
lines.zh: : 我想是明白了……不过……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么？

lines.en: : Why the fuck did you take so long to tell me this?
lines.zh: : 你他妈为什么拖了这么久才告诉我这些？

lines.en: scene mayalantern12
: Because I needed you to fail to a certain extent.
lines.zh: : 因为我需要你在一定程度上失败。

lines.en: : And you failed wonderfully.
lines.zh: : 而你失败得精彩绝伦。

lines.en: : Good job, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 干得好，Sensei。

lines.en: scene mayalantern13
: I really wish you didn’t go all the way with Ami, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我真希望你没有和 Ami 走到那一步。

lines.en: : I hate watching her get hurt after everything that she’s been through.
lines.zh: : 我讨厌看着她在经历了那么多之后还受伤。

lines.en: : You...
scene mayalantern14
: Did you really think you would be able to hide that from me?
lines.zh: : 你真以为你能瞒得住我？

lines.en: : Or, scratch that, did you really think {i}Ami{/i} would be able to hide that from me?
lines.zh: : 或者，换个说法，你真以为「{i}Ami{/i}」能瞒得住我？

lines.en: : We’re both [teenage]girls at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 说到底，我们两个都是[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : You are...surprisingly unfazed by this.
lines.zh: : 你……对这事出奇地平静。

lines.en: : Oh, I judge you harshly for it.
lines.zh: : 哦，我对此可是严厉地审判你。

lines.en: : I’m just used to it by now.
lines.zh: : 只是我已经习惯了。

lines.en: : Accepting your shortcomings and flaws is something I will never find joy in, but something I must do nonetheless.
lines.zh: : 接纳你的缺点和缺陷，是我永远无法从中找到快乐的事，却也是我不得不做的事。

lines.en: : Expecting you to make it through an entire loop without manipulating one of the girls into sex acts is like expecting me to not make it through without...
lines.zh: : 指望你能熬过一整个循环、而不把其中某个女孩哄骗去做性行为，就像指望我熬过一整个循环而不……

lines.en: : What is something weird or bad that I do?
lines.zh: : 我做的什么怪事或者坏事？

lines.en: : You talk about the sky a lot.
lines.zh: : 你老是聊天空。

lines.en: scene mayalantern7
: Yes, that. It’s like expecting me to make it through a loop without bringing up the sky.
lines.zh: : 对，就是这个。就像指望我熬过一整个循环而不提天空一样。

lines.en: : The key difference is that my crutch doesn’t hurt anyone and yours hurts everyone.
lines.zh: : 关键区别在于，我的癖好不会伤害任何人，而你的会伤害所有人。

lines.en: : Just not right away.
lines.zh: : 只是不会马上伤到。

lines.en: : It definitely hurts some of them right away.
lines.zh: : 其中有些人显然是马上就被伤到了。

lines.en: scene mayalantern3
: Why do you always have to ruin everything?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非得把一切都毁掉？

lines.en: : Just because I know about what you’re doing with everyone doesn’t mean I want to {i}hear{/i} about it.
lines.zh: : 就算我知道你和所有人都在做什么，也不代表我想{i}「听」{/i}你说这些。

lines.en: : Have some respect.
lines.zh: : 有点分寸。

lines.en: : I will. Because even though you allegedly know what I allegedly do in all of my alleged spare time...
lines.zh: : 我会的。因为即便你声称知道我声称在我声称的空闲时间里做的事……

lines.en: : You still haven’t done anything to make me pay for it.
lines.zh: : 你也至今没有做任何事让我为此付出代价。

lines.en: scene mayalantern11
: What would I do? I’m just a normal [teenage]girl.
lines.zh: : 我能做什么？我只是个普通的[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: : I don’t know. But I’m glad it’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。不过我很高兴你什么都没做。

lines.en: : Either way...I’ll see if I can talk to the others about how there’s definitely nothing going on between us.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样……我会试着去跟其他人说说，我们之间绝对什么都没有。

lines.en: scene mayalantern10
: Yeah. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 嗯。谢了。

lines.en: : That would be a big help.
lines.zh: : 那会帮上大忙。

lines.en: scene black
Maya and I remain situated at the booth for a little while longer.
lines.zh: Maya 和我在那间小屋里又待了一会儿。

lines.en: The sun retreats behind the clouds, creating a darkness that swallows me whole.
lines.zh: 太阳退到云层后面，造出一片把我整个吞没的黑暗。

lines.en: Maya remains safe, illuminated by the glow of her giant lanterns as I am left to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: Maya 安然无恙，被她那对巨大灯笼的光照亮，而我则被留在这儿，琢磨着接下来该往哪儿走。

lines.en: I learned a lot more than I normally do with Maya today.
lines.zh: 今天我从 Maya 这儿学到的东西比平时多得多。

lines.en: In fact, for the first time ever, I might be leaving with more answers than questions.
lines.zh: 事实上，有生以来第一次，我离开时带走的答案也许比问题更多。

lines.en: I should probably cherish this moment.
lines.zh: 我大概该珍惜这一刻。

lines.en: But for some reason-
lines.zh: 可不知为什么——

lines.en: I just keep worrying about her.
lines.zh: 我只是一直在为她担心。

lines.en: $ maya_love += 1
$ shrine30 = True
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
